title: The Scrollar Invariants of Curves Mapping to a Hirzebruch Surface
summary: In this note we analyse the scrollar invariants of $k:1$ covers of $\mathbb P^1$ that factor through the normalisation of a nodal curve in the $m$-th Hirzebruch surface $\mathbb F_m$. We then give an existence theorem for nodal curves in $\mathbb F_m$ having fixed class and singular locus.
